conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It prioritizes broad market exposure and income while significantly reducing leverage and concentration risk. Expect lower drawdowns but also slower growth.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.
Reduce leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, SPAL, PLTU) to small positions.
Add COP as a new position at 4% for diversification.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
It aims for steady growth with controlled drawdowns.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets approximately 2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a quality commodity name. It seeks risk-first growth, blending broad market exposure with select tech and commodity plays. Expect moderate growth and drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly return by increasing exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-potential sectors. It accepts higher risk, including amplified drawdowns and the daily rebalancing decay of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Add SPY to 20% for broad market stability.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, SPAL, PLTU) to zero.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return through distributions from income-generating assets like QQQI and SPY. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta single names, prioritizing capital preservation and steady cash flow. NAV can still decline in market downturns.
